ethics-by-design, safety and liability review, AI cybersecurity requirements, human control over lethal force

note: Content, title, number and date are supported by the stored PDFs. A targeted search found the 2021 Review of the plan (COM(2021) 205) on an official Commission site. It is not stored, so the status of the 2018 edition (current or Superseded) goes to a human and a later run should store the 2021 Review.
